title: Quick Savory Turkish Haggis Cig Kofte
description: A savory Turkish dish featuring haggis, this recipe is low-fat-friendly and made in a paella pan, perfect for a weeknight dinner. The cig kofte form gives it a unique and delicious twist.

ingredients.name: haggis
ingredients.notes: traditional Scottish dish made from sheep heart, liver, and lungs

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the haggis, onion, garlic, turkish spice blend, salt, and black pepper, and mix well with your hands or a wooden spoon until just combined.
Add the bulgur to the bowl and mix until the bulgur is evenly distributed.
Gradually add the low-fat beef broth to the bowl, mixing with your hands or a wooden spoon until the mixture forms a cohesive dough.
Knead the dough for about 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a long, thin cylinder, about 1 inch in diameter and 4 inches long.
Place the cig kofte in a paella pan or a large oven-safe skillet, leaving about 1 inch of space between each piece.
Bake the cig kofte in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until lightly browned on the outside and cooked through.
Serve the cig kofte hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
